name: workforce
description: An AI workforce platform: agents that remember, schedule, and delegate.

scripts.predev: npm run build:core && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green --kill-others "npm run dev --workspace @workforce/api" "npm run dev --workspace @workforce/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace @workforce/api
scripts.pretest:integration: npm run build:core && npm run db:migrate
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @workforce/core && npm run build --workspace @workforce/cli && npm run build --workspace @workforce/api && npm run build --workspace @workforce/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace @workforce/core && npm run typecheck:tests --workspace @workforce/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @workforce/web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm test --workspace @workforce/core && npm test --workspace @workforce/cli --workspace @workforce/api --workspace @workforce/web
